comment: Book of Stray Minutes, page 7 of 12: journeys on foot and holidays. The reward is a dreamseed: somewhere new to walk to.

reward.text: Full at last, the Minutes on Foot page has the tired, happy feel of boots set down by the door. In its spine is a dreamseed, as if the page thought you might like somewhere new to walk to.

collectibles.name: the sand-in-the-shoe minute
collectibles.text: the last minute of a summer holiday, sand still in one shoe

collectibles.name: the puddle minute
collectibles.text: the deepest puddle on the way home, and boots that were exactly tall enough

collectibles.name: the stile minute
collectibles.text: a rest on top of a stile halfway up the hill, with the whole valley folded out below

collectibles.name: the first-sea minute
collectibles.text: the sea, seen at last from the top of the cliff path after a whole morning of walking toward it

collectibles.name: the milk-jug minute
collectibles.text: a jug of milk carried home very carefully, and only a little of it spilled

collectibles.name: the stepping-stone minute
collectibles.text: the middle stepping stone, which wobbled, and the shriek, and the not falling in

collectibles.name: the wrong-turn minute
collectibles.text: a wrong turning into a lane full of foxgloves, and nobody minding at all

collectibles.name: the warm-wall minute
collectibles.text: an apple eaten on a sun-warmed wall, halfway to wherever it was

collectibles.name: the shell minute
collectibles.text: a shell held to one ear, with the sea still inside it

collectibles.name: the shoulder-ride minute
collectibles.text: the final stretch of the way home, half asleep, carried high on someone's shoulders

collectibles.name: the rockpool minute
collectibles.text: a tiny crab in a rockpool deciding at last that the large quiet face above it was only weather

collectibles.name: the signpost minute
collectibles.text: a crooked signpost pointing two ways at once, and the prettier way chosen

collectibles.name: the stick-race minute
collectibles.text: two sticks dropped from one side of a bridge, and two faces at the other rail to see whose came out first

collectibles.name: the nearly-home minute
collectibles.text: home's lit window, glimpsed through the trees at the end of a long walk
